# RTFMLicensing

> Swift package (macOS 13+, Swift 5.9+) that adds RTFM License Manager licensing to a macOS app: product key
> activation, offline use with signed leases, quiet renewal, deactivation, trials, and fixed-term or subscription
> keys. Version 0.1.0, MIT licensed. Package URL: https://github.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift

To integrate it, read the AI integration guide first and follow it exactly. It has the rules, the complete SwiftUI
code and a checklist. The app needs the developer's App integration file (`app-integration.json`, schema
`rtfm.app-integration.v1`), downloaded from the License Manager. It is public. Never write or edit it; ask the
developer for it if it is missing.

Key rules: one `RTFMLicense` per app; `await license.start()` once at launch; gate on `license.status.allowsUse`;
never block on the network or treat offline as an error; never log or store product keys; show
`LicensingError.refused`'s message as is; always offer deactivation; don't reimplement verification.

## Docs

- [AI integration guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift/main/docs/ai-integration-guide.md): instructions and code for coding assistants
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift/main/docs/getting-started.md): the License Manager setup, the package, the code, testing and shipping
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift/main/docs/reference.md): every public type, status, reason and refusal code
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common errors and their fixes

## Optional

- [Selling with FastSpring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jansenkarl/rtfm-licensing-swift/main/docs/fastspring.md): connecting a FastSpring store so each order gets a key
